verses.en: O LORD, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
verses.pt: Senhor, não me repreendas na tua ira, nem me castigues no teu furor.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker on corded instruments, on the Sheminith. A Psalm. Of David.> O Lord, do not be bitter with me in your wrath; do not send punishment on me in the heat of your passion.

verses.en: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; for I am weak: O LORD, heal me; for my bones are vexed.
verses.pt: Tem compaixão de mim, Senhor, porque sou fraco; sara-me, Senhor, porque os meus ossos estão perturbados.
verses.en_web: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am faint. Yahweh, heal me, for my bones are troubled.
verses.en_bbe: Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I am wasted away: make me well, for even my bones are troubled.

verses.en: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O LORD, how long?
verses.pt: Também a minha alma está muito perturbada; mas tu, Senhor, até quando?...
verses.en_web: My soul is also in great anguish. But you, Yahweh—how long?
verses.en_bbe: My soul is in bitter trouble; and you, O Lord, how long?

verses.en: Return, O LORD, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies’ sake.
verses.pt: Volta-te, Senhor, livra a minha alma; salva-me por tua misericórdia.
verses.en_web: Return, Yahweh. Deliver my soul, and save me for your loving kindness’ sake.
verses.en_bbe: Come back, O Lord, make my soul free; O give me salvation because of your mercy.

verses.en: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?
verses.pt: Pois na morte não há lembrança de ti; no Seol quem te louvará?
verses.en_web: For in death there is no memory of you. In Sheol, who shall give you thanks?
verses.en_bbe: For in death there is no memory of you; in the underworld who will give you praise?

verses.en: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.
verses.pt: Estou cansado do meu gemido; toda noite faço nadar em lágrimas a minha cama, inundo com elas o meu leito.
verses.en_web: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.
verses.en_bbe: The voice of my sorrow is a weariness to me; all the night I make my bed wet with weeping; it is watered by the drops flowing from my eyes.

verses.en: Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.
verses.pt: Os meus olhos estão consumidos pela mágoa, e enfraquecem por causa de todos os meus inimigos.
verses.en_web: My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.
verses.en_bbe: My eyes are wasting away with trouble; they are becoming old because of all those who are against me.

verses.en: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the LORD hath heard the voice of my weeping.
verses.pt: Apartai-vos de mim todos os que praticais a iniquidade; porque o Senhor já ouviu a voz do meu pranto.
verses.en_web: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for Yahweh has heard the voice of my weeping.
verses.en_bbe: Go from me, all you workers of evil; for the Lord has given ear to the voice of my weeping.

verses.en: The LORD hath heard my supplication; the LORD will receive my prayer.
verses.pt: O Senhor já ouviu a minha súplica, o Senhor aceita a minha oração.
verses.en_web: Yahweh has heard my supplication. Yahweh accepts my prayer.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord has given ear to my request; the Lord has let my prayer come before him.

verses.en: Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and be ashamed suddenly.
verses.pt: Serão envergonhados e grandemente perturbados todos os meus inimigos; tornarão atrás e subitamente serão envergonhados.
verses.en_web: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.
verses.en_bbe: Let all those who are against me be shamed and deeply troubled; let them be turned back and suddenly put to shame.
